name: EndeavorRx
description: A prescription video game for ADHD that targets attention function in children, used on its own or alongside other treatment.
evidence: FDA-authorized (2020) prescription digital therapeutic for children 8-17 with ADHD.

name: EndeavorOTC
description: The adult version of the Endeavor attention-training game, available without a prescription via subscription.
evidence: FDA-authorized (2025) over-the-counter digital therapeutic for adults with ADHD.
